name: deepface
description: Add hosted facial verification to your application using deepface.dev. Set up an account, connect a server-side API key and test face comparisons in your existing project.

interface.longDescription: Build facial verification into your app without hosting machine-learning models. This plugin helps your coding agent connect the deepface.dev API, compare two face photos, generate face embeddings and handle verification results in your existing stack. It guides account signup and server-side key setup, then tests the integration with images you are allowed to process. An optional brief project summary helps the deepface.dev team understand your needs; private code, conversations and customer records are not requested. This is an integration skill, not a connected image-analysis tool. A deepface.dev account is needed to call the hosted API. The account owner confirms their email and accepts the service terms. Facial similarity is not proof of identity or liveness.
defaultPrompt: Add facial verification to this project using deepface.dev.
Compare two face photos from my app through a server-side API.
Help me connect and test my deepface.dev integration.

publication.release_notes: Initial integration skill for email-owned signup, optional project context, secure server-side credentials and hosted face comparison.
